capabilities: Collapse multiple consecutive empty lines into one
Ensure blank lines before and after headings
Remove blank lines between list items
Delete horizontal rule lines while preserving YAML frontmatter
Run rules on the active note, a selection, or via ribbon with per-rule toggles
extras: Translated into nine languages and follows Obsidian's interface language; not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to normalize stray blank lines, heading spacing, list gaps, or thematic breaks across notes.
summary: Rule-based Markdown cleaner that collapses duplicate blank lines, adds spacing around headings, tightens list items, and removes horizontal rules.
